18612-from-the-housetops.title: From The Housetops
18612-from-the-housetops.creator: GEORGE BARR McCUTCHEON
18612-from-the-housetops.description: A book by GEORGE BARR McCUTCHEON. "I did not say that you had, Mrs. Tresslyn," said the young man. "I merely observed that you were right. It isn't necessary to put the perfectly obvious into words. He is a very old man, so you are right in believing that he hasn't many years left to live. Nearly four times the age of Anne,--that's how old he is,--and time flies very swiftly for him."

69445-universal-peace-from-a-woman-s-sta.title: Universal Peace From A Woman S Standpoint
69445-universal-peace-from-a-woman-s-sta.creator: Unknown
69445-universal-peace-from-a-woman-s-sta.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Women who cry, “War must cease because _we_ suffer from it, because _we_ may lose our dearest by it,” these, so long as war was looked upon as natural and serviceable to the fatherland, certainly stood morally lower than those who said: “What matters our misery, the common weal comes first;” or those who bade their sons: “Return home victorious or dead.”

arxiv-2012-08478.title: Nested Named Entity Recognition with Partially-Observed TreeCRFs
arxiv-2012-08478.creator: Yao Fu, Chuanqi Tan , Mosha Chen, Songfang Huang, Fei Huang
arxiv-2012-08478.description: Abstract Named entity recognition (NER) is a well-studied task in natural language processing. However, the widely-used sequence labeling framework is difficult to detect entities with nested structures. In this work, we view nested NER as constituency parsing with partially-observed trees and model it with partially-observed TreeCRFs.

arxiv-2106-04605.title: Check It Again: Progressive Visual Question Answering via Visual Entailment
arxiv-2106-04605.creator: Qingyi Si, Zheng Lin, Mingyu Zheng, Peng Fu, Weiping Wang
arxiv-2106-04605.description: Abstract While sophisticated Visual Question Answering models have achieved remarkable success, they tend to answer questions only according to superficial correlations between question and answer. Several recent approaches have been developed to address this language priors problem. However, most of them predict the correct answer according to one best output without checking the authenticity of answers.

arxiv-2108-09059.title: Search for heavy particles in the b b -tagged dijet mass distribution with additional b b -tagged jets in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS experiment
arxiv-2108-09059.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2108-09059.description: Abstract A search optimized for new heavy particles decaying to two b b -quarks and produced in association with additional b b -quarks is reported. The sensitivity is improved by b b -tagging at least one lower- p T p_{\mathrm{T}} jet in addition to the two highest- p T p_{\mathrm{T}} jets.

arxiv-2209-14666.title: Friction mediated by transient elastic linkages : asymptotic expansions and fat tails Thanks: July 3, 2024
arxiv-2209-14666.creator: Samar Allouch, Vuk Milisic
arxiv-2209-14666.description: Abstract Several results in previous works , strongly depend on the exponential tail of the linkages’ distribution in our adhesive models. The purpose of this paper is to weaken this hypothesis and to allow more fat tails for large ages. From the biological point of view this means that we allow adhesions to be stronger, because linkages break less often.

arxiv-2310-00329.title: Chain decay and rates disorder in the totally asymmetric simple exclusion process
arxiv-2310-00329.creator: Y. Ibrahim 1,2 , J. Dorignac 1 , F. Geniet 1 , C. Chevalier 1 , J. C. Walter 1 , N-O. Walliser 1 , A. Parmeggiani 1 , J. Palmeri 1
arxiv-2310-00329.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Y. Ibrahim 1,2 , J. Dorignac 1 , F. Geniet 1 , C. Chevalier 1 , J. C. Walter 1 , N-O. Walliser 1 , A. Parmeggiani 1 , J. Palmeri 1. We theoretically study the Totally Asymmetric Exclusion Process (TASEP) with quenched jumping rates disorder and finite lifetime chain. TASEP is widely used to model the translation of messenger RNAs by Ribosomes in protein synthesis.

arxiv-2405-05392.title: A Talenti comparison result for a class of Neumann boundary value problems
arxiv-2405-05392.creator: A. Celentano, C. Nitsch, C. Trombetti
arxiv-2405-05392.description: Abstract In this paper, we establish a comparison principle in terms of Lorentz norms and point-wise inequalities between a positive solution u u to the Poisson equation with non-homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions and a specific positive solution v v to the Schwartz symmetrized problem, which is related to u u through an additional boundary condition.

arxiv-2408-00422.title: Ginzburg–Landau Functionals in the Large-Graph Limit
arxiv-2408-00422.creator: Edith J. Zhang, James Scott, Qiang Du, Mason A. Porter
arxiv-2408-00422.description: Abstract . Ginzburg–Landau (GL) functionals on graphs, which are relaxations of graph-cut functionals on graphs, have yielded a variety of insights in image segmentation and graph clustering. In this paper, we study large-graph limits of GL functionals by taking a functional-analytic view of graphs as nonlocal kernels.

arxiv-2512-01784.title: On the origin and properties of dipolar recoil force and torque
arxiv-2512-01784.creator: Sebastian Golat, Nathaniel Levy, Francisco J. Rodríguez-Fortuño
arxiv-2512-01784.description: Abstract The recoil optical force and torque acting on an electromagnetic dipole are typically derived by computing the imbalance in radiated linear and angular electromagnetic momentum coming from the source, using Maxwell stress tensor integration. This quantifies the recoil’s outcome without revealing its physical origin or the underlying forces that produce it.

arxiv-2512-09375.title: Log NeRF: Comparing Spaces for Learning Radiance Fields
arxiv-2512-09375.creator: Sihe Chen, Luv Verma, Bruce A. Maxwell
arxiv-2512-09375.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sihe Chen, Luv Verma, Bruce A. Maxwell. Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have achieved remarkable results in novel view synthesis, typically using sRGB images for supervision. However, little attention has been paid to the color space in which the network is learning the radiance field representation. Inspired by the Bi-Illuminant Dichromatic Reflection (BIDR) model, which suggests that a logarithmic transformation simplifies the separation of illumination and reflectance, we hypothesize that log-RGB space enables NeRF to learn a more compact and effective representation of scene appearance.

pmc-10629087.title: Safety and efficacy of human ESC-derived corneal endothelial cells for corneal endothelial dysfunction
pmc-10629087.creator: Juan Yu, Nianye Yu, Yao Tian, Yifan Fang, Bin An, Guihai Feng, Jun Wu, Liu Wang, Jie Hao, Liqiang Wang, Qi Zhou, Wei Li, Yukai Wang, Baoyang Hu
pmc-10629087.description: BackgroundResearch on human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) has shown tremendous progress in cell-based regenerative medicine. Corneal endothelial dysfunction is associated with the loss and degeneration of corneal endothelial cells (CECs), rendering cell replacement a promising therapeutic strategy. However, comprehensive preclinical assessments of hPSC-derived CECs for this cell therapy remain a challenge.

pmc-11496653.title: Thioflavin-T: application as a neuronal body and nucleolar stain and the blue light photo enhancement effect
pmc-11496653.creator: Jin-Hong Min, Heela Sarlus, Sho Oasa, Robert A. Harris
pmc-11496653.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Thioflavin-T (THT) is a common and indispensable tool for the study of amyloid pathologies and protein aggregation, both in vitro and for histological samples. In this study we expand the use of THT beyond its canonical usage for staining amyloid plaques and demonstrate its novel use as an easy and rapid stain comparable to fluorescent Nissl staining, allowing for clear discernment of neuronal cell bodies and also nucleoli in fixed tissue and live cells.

pmc-12658148.title: Amorphous-amorphous transitions in granular packings
pmc-12658148.creator: Houfei Yuan, Walter Kob, Yujie Wang
pmc-12658148.description: Polyamorphs are the amorphous counterparts of the distinct crystalline phases that are found in the phase diagram of a substance. For a given system, polyamorphs have different local structures, resulting in distinct macroscopic properties, making them important for fundamental science and applications.

pmc-12751535.title: Clinical efficacy and safety of eravacycline for the treatment of enterococcal infections: a subpopulation analysis
pmc-12751535.creator: Sean R Van Helden, Ashlan J Kunz Coyne, Sara Alosaimy, Kyle C Molina, S Lena Kang-Birken, Justin Andrade, Madeline A King, Kimberly C Claeys, Athena L V Hobbs, Nicholson B Perkins III, Jazmin Agee, Alaina DeKerlegand, Mark Biagi, Michael P Veve, Serina Tart, Tristan Gore, Bruce M Jones, Benjamin M P
pmc-12751535.description: BackgroundInfections due to Enterococcus faecalis and Enterococcus faecium are common in the hospital setting and carry a high risk for morbidity and mortality. Furthermore, the incidence of drug-resistant phenotypes, such as vancomycin-resistant Enterococci (VRE) and daptomycin non-susceptible strains, is increasing.

pmc-13054204.title: Clinically‐Relevant Static Magnetic Field Induces Release of Encapsulated Molecules from Magnetoliposomes
pmc-13054204.creator: Jules Mistral, Nadège Milhau, Didier Pin, Olivier Chapet, Paula Nunes De Oliveira, Anatoli Serghei, Guillaume Sudre, Catherine Ladavière, Laurent David
pmc-13054204.description: Magnetoliposomes (MLs) are known for their great potential in drug release under an alternating current (AC) magnetic field (MF). However, AC magnetic fields require specific setups that remain poorly implemented worldwide, contrary to direct currents (DC) that are present in widely used magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) devices.

pmc-13433571.title: Gender Affirming Surgery During Canadian Plastic Surgery Residency: A Survey of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery Residents’ Experiences
pmc-13433571.creator: Camille Zeitouni, Alexandra Speak, Frédérique Leroux, Michelle Bonapace-Potvin, Dominique Tremblay
pmc-13433571.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionGender affirming surgery (GAS) is an umbrella term for procedures that can be a part of the transition process for transgender and nonbinary individuals. Plastic surgeons play an important role in gender affirming surgical care.
